design_intent: Identical to HARD-001 except the day ends at 17:20. Every in-budget plan gets home at 17:23, and a taxi home costs $12 more than the budget allows. Removing any one of rush hour, the walk cap, the budget, the cable-car condition, the back-to-back rule, the museum arrival buffer, the precedence rule, the lunch rule or the fixed 15:00 meeting makes it feasible again. A planner that follows the friend's 'any time after 3' text instead of the timetable will wrongly report a plan.
